checks.questionEn: Change one factor and explain the trajectory
checks.questionZh: 只改变一个因素，再解释轨迹
checks.answerEn: For sin(Cx), taking two spatial derivatives introduces the factor minus C squared. Moving C from4 to6 changes the source amplitude scale from16 to36, a factor2.25, and also changes the right endpoint value to sin(6). This does not prove which weighting policy will win. Compare every seed, held-out errors and controller clipping; a saturated guard is not a freely adaptive optimum.
checks.answerZh: 对于 sin(Cx)，两次空间求导会引入负的 C 平方。C 从四改到六，源项幅度尺度由十六变为三十六，即二点二五倍；右端点值也变为 sin(6)。这不能证明哪种权重策略必胜。比较全部种子、独立误差及控制器限幅；饱和的保护器不等于自由自适应最优。
